# arin_irr_route_set (Resource)

Manage a simple (XML) ARIN IRR route set. Owns its full description, remarks, membership, and membership-by-reference. POC links are generated by ARIN from the organization. Advanced RPSL objects are not supported. Import existing sets by name before managing them. Removing this resource from configuration deletes the route set from ARIN. The lifecycle is tested against a fake server and OT&E; production writes have not been validated.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Evaluate writes in OT&E using your organization handle.
resource "arin_irr_route_set" "example" {
  name           = "RS-EXAMPLE"
  org_handle     = "EXAMPLE-1"
  description    = ["Example routes"]
  members        = ["192.0.2.0/24", "198.51.100.0/24^+"]
  mp_members     = ["2001:db8::/32"]
  members_by_ref = ["MNT-EXAMPLE-1"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (List of String) Ordered description lines, at least one. Each entry is one nonempty line without surrounding whitespace.
- `name` (String) Uppercase route set name (for example RS-EXAMPLE or AS64496:RS-EXAMPLE). Changing it replaces the object.
- `org_handle` (String) Uppercase maintaining organization handle. Changing it replaces the object.

### Optional

- `members` (Set of String) IPv4 prefixes, uppercase route-set names, and prefix range expressions. Defaults to empty; omission clears explicit membership on apply.
- `members_by_ref` (Set of String) Maintainers in MNT-ORG format, or ANY. Defaults to empty; omission clears membership-by-reference on apply.
- `mp_members` (Set of String) IPv4 or IPv6 prefixes, route-set names, and prefix range expressions. Defaults to empty; omission clears this membership.
- `remarks` (List of String) Ordered remarks lines. Defaults to empty; omission clears existing remarks on apply.

### Read-Only

- `creation_date` (String) Creation timestamp reported by ARIN, or null when absent.
- `id` (String) route set name, also used as the import ID.
- `last_modified_date` (String) Last modification timestamp reported by ARIN, or null when absent.
- `poc_links` (Attributes Set) POC links generated by ARIN from the maintaining organization. These cannot be configured or changed on the route set. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--poc_links))

<a id="nestedatt--poc_links"></a>
### Nested Schema for `poc_links`

Read-Only:

- `function` (String) POC role returned by ARIN.
- `handle` (String) POC handle returned by ARIN.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import arin_irr_route_set.example RS-EXAMPLE
```
